column1: # Game profile of Bayonetta (Switch, update v65536 = 1.1; English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese)
# PlatinumGames' own engine in its Wii U form on NVN, SDK 3.6.0, as Bayonetta 2 (the same sdk and subsdk0 builds). Modules main + subsdk0 (NVN's GLSLC, which main imports) + sdk; CRI's file
# system (CPK), ADX2 sound (se/ and bgm/: .acf / .awb) and Sofdec movies (USM), all decoded by the game's own code.
# RomFS: nine CRI CPK archives (data00.cpk …, 4.25 GB) holding PlatinumGames DAT archives, beside the USM movies (movie/) and the sound. The shaders are BNSH files, one stage each ('.vso' /
# '.pso' members of shader.dat in data00.cpk; shader_split.py cpk_jobs, cpk.py)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# full: the camera is on the right stick
# load order as on Horizon: main, subsdk*, sdk (subsdk0 = GLSLC)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): nninitStartup sets a heap of the pool − used memory. The 4 GB block of the other games without virtual address memory
# (256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region)
# the rewritten modules are larger than the default 64 MB of used memory (the game's SetHeapSize asks for pool − used)
# ---- Shader split (shader_split.py; the BNSH files in data00.cpk) ----
